eric-app-builder 10.0.0

- Major update introducing a comprehensive full-stack app building framework from natural language requests.
- Defines structured approaches for project detection, tech stack selection (2025 defaults), scaffolding patterns, implementation planning, and feature building.
- Provides detailed project type keyword matrix and matching recommended stacks.
- Outlines a modular, feature-isolated Next.js-Tailwind-Prisma-Supabase project structure with sample directory tree and path aliasing.
- Includes step-by-step workflows for structured implementation planning, iterative feature building, error handling, and development coordination.
- Guides on requirement analysis, task breakdown, error recovery, and user confirmation before code execution.
